utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely — folks are dropping off tools and spare parts already. If you’re heading over, I can walk with you.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oh, really? Are you sure it’s actually picking up already?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, from what I heard, it is — there were a few donations this morning and more coming in later. I can swing by with you if you want to check it out together.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure folks know when to show up.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — I probably would’ve missed that otherwise. Just let me know when and where, and I’ll try to be there.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what needs doing first?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Leo — first we need to sort the donated tools and check what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll sort the tools first, then I’ll make a missing list.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — we still need a few supplies, especially duct tape, screws, and a couple of flashlights.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can pick up some duct tape and screws today. Do you want the flashlights too?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can work around school drop-off and pickup, so just let me know when the repair drive is happening.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Faye — that’s really helpful. I’ll send you the repair drive time as soon as we lock it in.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks Jules. Just text me once it’s set and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear plan for the repair drive—what’s the first stop, and when are we heading out?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—let’s start at my place first, then we can head out around 9. I’ll grab the tools and meet you outside.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—I'll be outside at 9 and ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m already telling folks about the repair drive—everyone should come by if they can. Want me to pass your name along?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll put your name down and let folks know to expect you.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve just been hearing bits and pieces about the repair drive—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We’re lining up the repair list now and matching folks with the right helpers. If you’ve got a spot that needs attention, send it my way and I’ll add it in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll pass along what I hear. I’ve just been catching second-hand updates, so I may need a little help keeping up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d like to double-check the repair drive details before I commit—what time and where should I show up?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m sorry, I don’t have the details in front of me yet—let me check and get back to you right away.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mara — I’ll wait for your update before I make any plans.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m still trying to sort out what I can contribute, but I appreciate you checking in about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No worries — I’m glad to help however I can, even if I’m a bit late to the conversation. Just tell me what’s still needed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. I’m still figuring out the biggest gaps, but I can let you know as soon as I do.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mina — I’ve got a few tools I can lend for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. What tools do you have available?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a hammer, a screwdriver set, a tape measure, and a cordless drill you can borrow.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I don’t have any repair-drive details yet, but I can keep track if you want to share the location.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can share it when I have it—just keep track for me.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely—I’ll keep track once you share the location.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and bring whatever tools you need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I’ll let you know what tools we need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem — just give me a shout when you’ve got the list, and I’ll round up the tools.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d want to check the timing and pickup details first. If we can sort the logistics, I’m in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, can you confirm what timing works for you and where you’d want pickup?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m free after 6 on weekdays, and Saturday mornings could work too. Pickup near my place would be easiest, but I’d need the exact time so I can plan ahead.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’m happy to help connect everyone for the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules — could you help spread the word and keep a list of neighbors who want to join? I’ll share the repair drive details and times next.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and start a list of neighbors who want to join. Send me the details and times when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help keep an eye on what supplies we still need for the repair drive. What’s the biggest gap right now?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what do you need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re probably short on basic tools and sturdy tape most of all. If you can check for those, I’ll keep tracking the rest.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting a nice turnout already — folks seem ready to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’s great to hear — I’m glad people are showing up for it. I’ll make sure our school schedule doesn’t get in the way of helping.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s thoughtful of you, Faye — I’m sure everyone will appreciate it. If you want, I can pass along the schedule so folks know when to stop by.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what time and what do I need to bring?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Let’s meet at 10 a.m. in the community room, and please bring any tools you already have plus a list of the repairs you’re hoping to tackle.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — 10 a.m. in the community room. I’ll bring my tools and a repair list.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, but I’m not sure yet—what time are people coming by, and do I need to bring anything?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: People can stop by between 10 and 2, and you don’t need to bring anything unless you want to help load stuff.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it, thanks — I can probably help load for a bit if you need me.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away. If Nell wants, I can also ask a few neighbors to bring tools or snacks.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, thanks, Quinn — I’m still catching up on everything, so any tools or snacks would really help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You got it — I’ll ask around and see who can bring what, and I’ll keep you posted.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help keep track of where we’re headed for the repair drive—just tell me the first stop.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s start at the hardware store, then the parts shop after that.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — hardware store first, then the parts shop.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did the repair drive already start, or are we still setting it up?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m not sure yet — let me check the details before I say for certain.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — can you check who’s coordinating it and when it’s supposed to begin?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m running errands. Let me know if there’s anything specific you want me to check on for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — if you spot any extra tools or spare parts at the curb, could you let me know? I’m trying to keep track of what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’ll keep an eye out for any extra tools or spare parts and let you know right away if I see anything.
